integration.fullIntegratedGateOwner: Separate $fix-ci chat; full gate success is not claimed by this candidate report
integration.timingsScope: Isolated candidate versus frozen B7, not a reprofile of concurrent CI fixes or full main

scope: Only the four pending performance candidates. Existing networking, cadence, content, balance and knowledge limits are preserved.

method.phase: Mean update milliseconds per run; discard first 300 of 3601 samples, retain 3301; report median of three run means
method.wholeProcess: Process wall seconds, median of three runs; captures without phase instrumentation
method.validity: All six runs per role/mode complete; no compiler; original background CPU <=1 core cap; pinned binary/source/content proofs; full gameplay-report equivalence excluding only three wall-clock latency quantiles; phase final-digest equality
method.decision: Manual review of qualified evidence and repeatability. Negative percentage means faster. No noisy-run omissions, no acceptance threshold changes.
method.build: Normal measure profile: opt3, thin LTO,16 codegen units; same profile for every candidate and control

correctness.scope: Selected Model/Contracts/Gameplay/Simulation owner tests, including all four candidates together. Individual owner tests are recorded separately per candidate.

limitations: Two fixed-seed headless scenarios are not a comprehensive workload suite.
Phase final digests are not a full mission save/resume replay.
Browser/native-device acceptance and full repository gates are not established by these owner tests.
Old-speed recovery is not established by these candidate comparisons.
Timings measure isolated candidates against frozen B7. Concurrent CI fixes and the complete integrated main tree were not reprofiled in this report.
